verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a first-party MCP Server for AI tools that cannot run shell commands, and a CLI for working with Langfuse from a terminal or coding agent. Together these let a user drive the product through an external AI agent using natural language. There is no evidence of a native in-product natural-language command interface, and the evidence never says which operations the MCP server or CLI expose. The docs-MCP item is about getting a coding agent to add tracing to your codebase, not about operating Langfuse itself. Missing for 10: native natural-language command interface inside the Langfuse UI, documentation of which actions are exposed via MCP/CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
